gaps_html:
About the Ireland data

Built from the Ireland research files (29 records, 24 accounts; main pass 2 July 2026, refresh 15 October 2026): ireland/projects.csv, territory-plan.md and sources.md. Amounts, dates, notes and confidence are as written there. The county coordinates, the Orise fit ratings, the opportunity status and the account tiers were added when loading: fit strength follows the plan's overall grade (A+ to A- Strong, B+ to B- Moderate, C and watch Weak) and the areas are matched from the wording of each note. Tiers follow the plan's own groupings (Tier 1 anchors, Tier 2 mid-large, Tier 3 focused builds, Tier 4 watch, divesting or other domain). Open means grades A- to B or a high-fit refresh item; Closed/late marks divested sites and completed pre-window builds.

  • Totals are a floor. The MSD Dundalk figure is an acquisition price; the Pfizer Ringaskiddy facility is part of the €1.2bn package; MSD's network jobs, Novartis, GSK, Roche, Servier, PCI and West have no counted amount. USD amounts are converted at 1 USD = 0.86 EUR.
  • Figures that disagree in the files: Alexion is €65M (IDA) in the plan but a USD 360M programme in the CSV (the €65M is counted); MSD Dundalk is ">€500M" while USD 520M converts to about €447M; Regeneron is €100M confirmed against about €200M reported (€100M counted); Novo Athlone appears as €432M in the plan and as USD 372.5M in one source.
  • Greenfield / brownfield was not in the CSV. I classed Lilly Raheen, Pfizer DS2, Abbott Kilkenny and Astellas as greenfield and everything else as brownfield; check this.

Gaps and next steps (from the territory plan)

  1. IDA Ireland press-release pages return 403 to the research tools. Open them in a browser to confirm quotes and figures (Pfizer, Alexion, Novo, MSD, Amgen, Abbott, AbbVie, Astellas).
  2. Alexion APICOM: confirm the April 2026 opening wording and whether the facility is API or biologics drug substance.
  3. Lilly Raheen: confirm whether biologics production started in 2026. Pfizer: confirm the current phase (design, construction or C&Q).
  4. Astellas: automation and MES scope, EPC and integrator, and contacts. The referenced astellas-battlecard.md was not in the files provided.
  5. Planning portals (An Coimisiún Pleanála and the county registers) for J&J Ringaskiddy land, Sanofi Waterford, Pfizer Ringaskiddy and Regeneron's main building.
  6. Add Sterling Pharma Solutions (ex-Novartis Ringaskiddy) and Thermo Fisher (ex-GSK Cork) as formal targets once their modernisation plans are researched. APC (Dublin) and other emerging CDMOs were not found.
  7. Earnings-call transcripts (MSD, Lilly, Pfizer, J&J, Takeda, AbbVie) for Ireland capex commentary; Amgen's ex-Horizon divestment and the Merck KGaA mothballed API plant need site-level clarification.
  8. Decide whether Orise pursues device and diagnostics manufacturing (Abbott €440M) or biopharma GMP only.
  9. Technical buyers (automation and MES managers, CSV leads, historian owners) still need LinkedIn mapping; no emails, phone numbers or LinkedIn URLs were collected.
